task/tests/test.sh:25-31 cleanup sends TERM then unbounded wait; generated restart helper at :145-174 never confirms old group died or new PID owns port before probe_ready accepts any HTTP response. File is byte-identical to frozen shared template; this is a shared-policy limitation, not a task edit.
quality.counterexample: A SIGTERM-resistant old server remains bound to 3000. The restart helper starts a replacement that exits on EADDRINUSE, then probe_ready reads the old server and reports ready; the restart durability row can award credit without a process restart. On final cleanup, wait for the resistant group can hang.
quality.suggested_fix: In a coordinated shared-template fix, bound TERM with KILL fallback and require old-group exit plus new PID/process liveness and port ownership before restart_app reports success.
